facebook.content_angle: How East Auckland sellers who ask the right questions before choosing an agent consistently avoid costly mistakes and achieve stronger results in the final weeks of the autumn market
facebook.post_text:
Choosing the wrong agent in this market could cost you tens of thousands. 🏡

Most East Auckland homeowners spend more time researching appliances than interviewing agents. And in the final weeks of autumn, that decision matters more than ever.

👉 Not all agents have genuine local knowledge of what buyers in East Auckland are paying right now
👉 Marketing strategy varies enormously — and poor exposure directly impacts your final price
👉 Negotiation skill at the table is where premium results are actually won or lost

The right agent doesn't just list your home — they package it, position it, and fight for every dollar. 💪

✔️ Ask to see recent comparable sales in your specific suburb
✔️ Ask how they handle multiple offers and what their negotiation process looks like
✔️ Ask for a clear marketing plan — not just a promise

Winter is weeks away. The sellers who move now with the right support are the ones who look back with no regrets.

What's one question you wish you'd asked before making a big property decision?
